description: This file implements internal utility functions and handlers for distributed nonlinear reduction operations, specifically for argmin/argmax and min/max with dimension options in a PyTorch distributed tensor context. It manages sharding, local/global index conversions, and reduction logic.

methods.name: OutputSharding _get_output_sharding( op_call: torch._ops.OpOverload, args: tuple[object, ...], kwargs: dict[str, object], )
methods.description: Retrieves and propagates the output sharding for a given distributed operation call.

methods.description: Prepares and normalizes arguments for nonlinear reduction ops, handling local/global shape, device mesh, and placements.

methods.name: torch.Size _get_expected_shape( local_tensor: torch.Tensor, dim: Optional[int], keepdim: bool )
methods.description: Calculates the expected output shape after reduction based on input shape, dimension, and keepdim flag.

methods.name: list[int] _collect_shard_mesh_dims( op_call_repr: str, local_tensor: torch.Tensor, placements: tuple[Placement, ...], dim: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Identifies which mesh dimensions are sharded along the specified reduction dimension.

methods.name: tuple[int,torch.Tensor] _convert_to_global_idxs( local_idx: torch.Tensor, global_shape: torch.Size, device_mesh: "torch.distributed.device_mesh.DeviceMesh", placements: tuple[Placement, ...], dim: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Converts local tensor indices to global indices accounting for the distributed device mesh and placements.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor] _gather_tensors( gather_dim: int, gathered_idxs: torch.Tensor, local_redux: torch.Tensor, device_mesh: "torch.distributed.device_mesh.DeviceMesh", shard_mesh_dims: list[int], )
methods.description: Gathers local min/max values and indices across sharded devices to form globally consistent tensors.

methods.description: Handles distributed argmin/argmax operations by coordinating local computation and global gathering of indices.

methods.description: Handles distributed min/max operations with specified dimension, coordinating local reduction and global gathering.
